verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Gazebo ships versioned libraries and packages (e.g. gz-sim10-server, docs/latest, ROS/Gazebo version-compatibility guidance) but nowhere documents a formal API deprecation policy or versioning guarantees for AI-native/agentic consumption; probes for machine-readable API specs (openapi.json, llms.txt) all 404, further indicating no structured versioned-API contract is published.
